title: Inspect and cancel the exact one-off job
goal: Distinguish queued work from completion; dynamically identify and remove only the owned practice job.
challenge: Submit the declared harmless learner job for now+2minutes, inspect its actual ID/owner/body, cancel only that job, and prove no result after its due time while all unrelated queued rows remain byte-identical. No fixed IDs, all-job cancellation or spool editing.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/foundation-at-queue.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && umask 077; here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/foundation-at-queue.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700; }; fresh() { here && test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test ! -e "$1" && test ! -L "$1"; }; regular() { here && test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$1")" = learner:600:1; }; jobid() { regular "$1" || return 19; job=$(awk '$1=="job" && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ {print $2}' "$1"); case "$job" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 19;; *) test "$job" -gt 0;; esac; }; here && test "$(df -B1 --output=avail / | tail -1)" -ge 1073741824 && systemctl is-active atd && pwd
steps.explanation: Record the private path/definitions. Refuse collisions and insufficient space; Resume reuses the recorded workspace, not a new job.
steps.expected: Owned700 workspace, actual atd and observed1GiB reserve.

steps.command: foundation_step() { here && fresh "$w/foreign-queued.log" || return 19; printf '/usr/bin/true\n' | sudo /usr/sbin/runuser -u ll-at-allow -- /usr/bin/at -M now + 30 minutes > foreign-queued.log 2>&1 && jobid "$w/foreign-queued.log" && fresh "$w/foreign-queue.txt" && sudo atq > foreign-queue.txt && awk -v id="$job" '$1==id && $NF=="ll-at-allow" {f=1} END {exit !f}' foreign-queue.txt; }; foundation_step
steps.explanation: Create only this separately recorded harmless comparison job. It must survive learner-job cancellation; later cancel it exactly as its owner. Do not treat the root queue as learner-owned.
steps.expected: Known ll-at-allow comparison job remains queued.

steps.command: here && fresh "$w/queue-before.txt" && sudo atq > queue-before.txt && fresh "$w/job.sh" && printf 'set -C || exit 92\nprintf "cancelled-job-ran\\n" > "%s/cancelled-result"\n' "$w" > job.sh && regular "$w/job.sh" && fresh "$w/cancelled-result" && fresh "$w/queued.log" && at -M -f job.sh now + 2 minutes > queued.log 2>&1 && jobid "$w/queued.log" && fresh "$w/queue-during.txt" && sudo atq > queue-during.txt && awk -v id="$job" '$1==id && $NF=="learner" {f=1} END {exit !f}' queue-during.txt
steps.explanation: Dynamically capture the exact owned job ID and unchanged unrelated rows. A queued job is not a completed job.
steps.expected: One declared future learner job with retained ownership evidence.

steps.command: here && jobid "$w/queued.log" && fresh "$w/body.txt" && timeout -k 1s 10s at -c "$job" > body.txt && grep -F "$w/cancelled-result" body.txt && atrm "$job" && fresh "$w/queue-after.txt" && sudo atq > queue-after.txt && cmp queue-before.txt queue-after.txt && test ! -e "$w/cancelled-result" && test ! -L "$w/cancelled-result"
steps.explanation: Inspect the expected body/path before exact cancellation. Never assume a fixed job number or remove all jobs. Immediate absence is observed; wait until the recorded due time for stronger absence evidence.
steps.expected: Owned cancellation; identical other queue rows; no immediate result.

steps.command: here && sleep 130 && test ! -e "$w/cancelled-result" && test ! -L "$w/cancelled-result" && fresh "$w/queue-deadline.txt" && sudo atq > queue-deadline.txt && cmp queue-before.txt queue-deadline.txt
steps.explanation: This bounded wait exceeds the now+2minutes deadline, without changing the clock. Retain cancellation evidence and no-result check.
steps.expected: Cancelled output absent after its due time, unrelated queue unchanged.

steps.command: foundation_step() { here && jobid "$w/foreign-queued.log" && fresh "$w/foreign-before-cleanup.txt" && sudo atq > foreign-before-cleanup.txt && awk -v id="$job" '$1==id && $NF=="ll-at-allow" {f=1} END {exit !f}' foreign-before-cleanup.txt && fresh "$w/foreign-body.txt" && sudo /usr/sbin/runuser -u ll-at-allow -- at -c "$job" > foreign-body.txt && grep -Fx /usr/bin/true foreign-body.txt || return 19; sudo /usr/sbin/runuser -u ll-at-allow -- atrm "$job" && fresh "$w/foreign-after-cleanup.txt" && sudo atq > foreign-after-cleanup.txt && ! awk -v id="$job" '$1==id {f=1} END {exit !f}' foreign-after-cleanup.txt; }; foundation_step
steps.explanation: After comparison, cancel only the positively matched declared comparison job. This does not authorize cancelling an unrelated owner job.
steps.expected: Comparison job safely removed; unrelated rows preserved.

hints: Never fixed job numbers, atrm all, global spool edits or count-only proof; root atq sees others.
Use the actual dynamically captured job ID and successful owner-matched queue queries; a command failure is not an empty queue.
Inspect actual result ownership, bytes and exit status; cancel only positively matched pending work before exact rollback.
review: I demonstrated the selected mode’s facts, actual identities/results and an incorrect interpretation or attempt.
I can separate queueing, execution, access policy and self-reviewed reasoning. Completion is unscored and not automatic verification.
I removed only positively matched owned jobs, restored any exact policy fixture and retained evidence; no authentication or host changes.
coverage: LPIC-1 active v5.0 partial 108.2 at/atq/atrm. No full objective, automatic assessment or endorsement. The plan’s 107.2 at tags were corrected to active108.2;107.2 concerns display/X11.
